decisions.reason: Define-XML ADSL.VISNUMEN and workbook Methods row 133 both specify literal DSTERM='PROTCOL COMPLETED', which P4_PROTCOL and the VISNUMEN probe retain with the 13-to-12 replacement. No staged DS record has that literal term, so the probe is missing against all 254 nonmissing reference values as reported.
Define-XML ADSL.TRTSDT specifies SV.SVSTDTC at VISITNUM=3, while adsl.yaml EX_FIRST and TRTSDT use the earliest EX.EXSTDTC. These are different documented and implemented sources.

Define-XML ADSL.TRTEDT specifies EXENDTC on the last EX record; adsl.yaml TRTEDT instead maximizes EXENDT_CAPPED across exposure records. The specification neither selects the last EX record nor preserves its uncapped end date.

Define-XML ADSL.TRTEDT permits discontinuation date only when final dose is missing and discontinuation follows Visit 3. The complete adsl.yaml TRTEDT aggregate and DS_EOS contain no corresponding missing-dose and after-Visit-3 conditions.

Define-XML ADSL.CUMDOSE describes arm-specific planned doses and visit-defined dosing intervals. The adsl.yaml CUMDOSE aggregate instead sums EX.EXDOSE multiplied by exposure-interval duration, without the documented arm branches and visit boundaries.

Define-XML ADSL.AGEGR1 explicitly derives the character category from ADSL.AGEGR1N. In adsl.yaml AGEGR1 is derived from DM.AGE and AGEGR1N is subsequently mapped from AGEGR1, reversing that named dependency.

Define-XML ADSL.AGEGR1N states the three age intervals and their numeric codes; adsl.yaml AGEGR1 implements those intervals and AGEGR1N maps their labels to the same codes. Resolving the helper dependency supplies counterparts for the documented conditions and computation, so this is not a missing direct-age clause.

Define-XML ADSL.RACEN and its CL.RACEN codelist explicitly assign ASIAN to 7 and NATIVE HAWAIIAN OR OTHER PACIFIC ISLANDER to 5. The entire adsl.yaml RACEN mapping contains only the other three categories, with no counterpart elsewhere in the specification.

Define-XML ADSL.SAFFL requires ITTFL='Y' and a nonmissing TRTSDT; adsl.yaml SAFFL inlines exactly the predicate that its ITTFL column uses for 'Y' and adds the same TRTSDT check. The separate ITTFL finding addresses its screen-failure predicate, while the SAFFL condition itself has a counterpart.
Define-XML ADSL.ITTFL states a nonblank ARMCD predicate. The adsl.yaml ITTFL condition additionally excludes the nonblank value 'Scrnfail', which that literal method does not exclude.

Define-XML ADSL.EFFFL requires any post-Visit-3 ADAS-Cog questionnaire record. The adsl.yaml N_ACTOT helper specifically requires QSTESTCD='ACTOT', narrowing the documented questionnaire condition to its total-score test.

Define-XML ADSL.COMP8FL requires both a Visit 8 record and ENDDT at or after that visit date. The complete adsl.yaml N_WK8 and COMP8FL logic checks only record existence, with no end-date comparison elsewhere.

Define-XML ADSL.COMP16FL requires both a Visit 10 record and ENDDT at or after that visit date. The complete adsl.yaml N_WK16 and COMP16FL logic checks only record existence, with no end-date comparison elsewhere.

Define-XML ADSL.COMP24FL requires both a Visit 12 record and ENDDT at or after that visit date. The complete adsl.yaml N_WK24 and COMP24FL logic checks only record existence, with no end-date comparison elsewhere.

Define-XML ADSL.DISCONFL tests the grouped DCREASCD against 'Completed'; IG.ADSL links that method name to DCSREAS. The adsl.yaml DISCONFL instead tests raw DS_EOS.DSDECOD and adds a nonmissing DSSTDTC condition, so the implemented predicate still differs even after resolving the method link.

Define-XML ADSL.DSRAEFL tests the grouped DCREASCD value, whose method is attached to DCSREAS in IG.ADSL. The adsl.yaml DSRAEFL bypasses that grouping and tests DS_EOS.DSDECOD directly, including records for which the specification's DCSREAS override can assign 'I/E Not Met'.

Define-XML ADSL.DTHFL states DM.DTHFL as a copy source. The adsl.yaml DTHFL case reads that field but retains only 'Y', replacing every other possible value with missing rather than copying it unchanged.

Define-XML ADSL.DURDIS names DISONSET, while adsl.yaml DURDISD uses DISONSDT with VISIT1DT. Neither the retained sections nor the original workbook and Define-XML explicitly identify DISONSET as an alias of DISONSDT.

Define-XML ADSL.VISNUMEN requires DS.VISITNUM from the literal 'PROTCOL COMPLETED' disposition record. The adsl.yaml SV_LAST and VISNUMEN instead use a selected subject-visit record without that disposition predicate.

Define-XML ADSL.MMSETOT names QS.QSORRES as the summed source within MINI-MENTAL STATE. The adsl.yaml MMSETOT aggregate uses QS.QSSTRESN, a different source column even where its numeric values agree.

The original Define-XML IT.ADSL.STUDYID at lines 601-610 explicitly gives Origin Type='Predecessor' with DM.STUDYID, and workbook Variables row 143 records the same predecessor. This documents the specification's copy derivation despite its omission from the projected ADSL.STUDYID section.

The original Define-XML IT.ADSL.USUBJID at lines 612-621 explicitly gives Origin Type='Predecessor' with DM.USUBJID, and workbook Variables row 144 records the same predecessor. This documents the specification's copy derivation despite its omission from the projected ADSL.USUBJID section.

Define-XML ADSL.SITEGR1 and workbook Methods row 122 name SAP Section 7.1 but provide no criterion for deciding which sites to pool. No retained section supplies that criterion, and the source manifest leaves the shared SAP's applicability pending_review.

Define-XML ADSL.TRTSDT states date conversion only; no retained section documents adsl.yaml TRTSDT's January and last-day completion. ADRG page-8 and Define-XML ADAE.ASTDT restrict their partial-date convention to AE start dates and do not supply this ADSL rule.

Define-XML ADSL.TRTEDT states discontinuation date as a conditional fallback for missing final dose. The adsl.yaml TRTEDT least(EXENDT_RAW, EOSDT) instead caps exposure dates at disposition date, and no retained section or workbook method states that cap.

Define-XML ADSL.TRTEDT and workbook Methods row 130 state conversion to a SAS date without completing partial EXENDTC dates. No retained section states the January and last-day completion used in adsl.yaml TRTEDT; the ADRG page-8 convention concerns ADAE.ASTDT.

Define-XML ADSL.AVGDD states CUMDOSE/TRTDURD, which already has no defined quotient at a zero denominator. The adsl.yaml AVGDD_RAW NULLIF guard preserves that undefined result as missing and leaves the documented quotient unchanged, rather than adding a distinct derivation rule.

Define-XML ADSL.CUMDOSE specifies visit-defined dose intervals and does not state an EXENDTC-to-disposition cap. No retained section or workbook method states the least(EXENDT_RAW, EOSDT) computation used in the adsl.yaml CUMDOSE aggregate.

Define-XML ADSL.CUMDOSE and workbook Methods row 99 state dose-interval formulas without partial-date completion. No retained section states the January and last-day completion of EXSTDTC used in adsl.yaml CUMDOSE; the ADRG page-8 convention is specific to ADAE.ASTDT.

Define-XML ADSL.CUMDOSE requires ARMN groups 0, 1 and 2 and the undefined TRTSTDT source, while its treatment codelist supplies dose codes 0, 54 and 81. Although IG.ADSL links TRTDURD to method MT.ADSL.TRTDUR, no retained section or original workbook resolves the remaining arm recoding and start-date identifiers sufficiently to state the literal probe.

Define-XML ADSL.COMP8FL and workbook Methods row 98 require ENDDT but never define that identifier. Searches of all retained sections and original metadata do not identify it with either RFENDT or TRTEDT, leaving the date condition unresolved.

Define-XML ADSL.COMP16FL and workbook Methods row 96 require ENDDT but never define that identifier. Searches of all retained sections and original metadata do not identify it with either RFENDT or TRTEDT, leaving the date condition unresolved.

Define-XML ADSL.COMP24FL and workbook Methods row 97 require ENDDT but never define that identifier. Searches of all retained sections and original metadata do not identify it with either RFENDT or TRTEDT, leaving the date condition unresolved.

Define-XML ADSL.BMIBL states WEIGHTBL/((HEIGHTBL/100)**2), whose denominator is already undefined for division when height is zero. The adsl.yaml BMIBL_RAW NULLIF guard preserves that undefined quotient as missing and otherwise implements the same formula, rather than adding a distinct BMI rule.

Define-XML ADSL.HEIGHTBL and workbook Methods row 112 specify HEIGHT at Visit 1 but do not select among multiple qualifying measurements. No retained section states the earliest-VSDTC ordering that adsl.yaml VS_HT adds.

Define-XML ADSL.WEIGHTBL and workbook Methods row 134 specify WEIGHT at Visit 3 but do not select among multiple qualifying measurements. No retained section states the earliest-VSDTC ordering that adsl.yaml VS_WT adds.

Original SDTM Define-XML SC at lines 1863-1870 declares one record per characteristic per subject and keys STUDYID, USUBJID, SCTESTCD. With ADSL.EDUCLVL's documented EDLEVEL selection, adsl.yaml SC_ED orders a singleton, so keep:first does not introduce a distinct record-selection rule.

Define-XML ADSL.DISONSDT and workbook Methods row 103 state conversion of the primary-diagnosis MHSTDTC without partial-date completion. No retained section states the January and first-day completion used by adsl.yaml DISONSDT; the ADRG page-8 convention applies to ADAE.ASTDT.

Define-XML ADSL.DISONSDT specifies MHCAT='PRIMARY DIAGNOSIS' but no choice among multiple such history events. No retained section or workbook method states adsl.yaml MH_DX's earliest-MHSTDTC selection.

Define-XML ADSL.DURDIS and workbook Methods row 106 state only the number of months between two dates. No retained section states the inclusive day count used in adsl.yaml DURDISD before conversion to months.
Define-XML ADSL.DURDIS and workbook Methods row 106 state months without defining a day-to-month divisor. No retained section supplies the 30.4375 divisor used by adsl.yaml DURDIS_RAW.

Define-XML ADSL.DURDIS and workbook Methods row 106 name DISONSET without defining it and do not specify how to calculate months. Searches of the retained sections and original metadata supply neither an explicit source alias nor a complete month-arithmetic convention.

Define-XML ADSL.VISIT1DT and workbook Methods row 132 state conversion of the Visit 1 start date only. No retained section states the January and first-day completion used by adsl.yaml VISIT1DT; ADRG page-8's partial-date statement applies to ADAE.ASTDT.

Original SDTM Define-XML SV at lines 971-978 declares one record per actual visit per subject and keys STUDYID, USUBJID, VISITNUM. After ADSL.VISIT1DT's documented VISITNUM=1 selection, adsl.yaml SV_V1 orders a singleton, so keep:first does not introduce a distinct tie-break rule.

Define-XML ADSL.VISNUMEN and workbook Methods row 133 specify a disposition term and the 13-to-12 replacement without a VISITNUM<100 cutoff. Searches of all retained sections reveal no counterpart for the cutoff in adsl.yaml SV_LAST.

Define-XML ADSL.VISNUMEN states the 13-to-12 replacement but no rounding of fractional visit numbers. Neither the retained sections nor workbook Methods row 133 states the nearest-integer rounding used by adsl.yaml VISNUMEN_ROUND.

Define-XML ADSL.RFENDT and workbook Methods row 117 state RFENDTC converted to a SAS date without partial-date completion. No retained section states the January and first-day completion in adsl.yaml RFENDT; ADRG page-8's convention is limited to ADAE.ASTDT.

Define-XML ADSL.DCDECOD and workbook Methods row 100 specify DSCAT='DISPOSITION EVENT' without excluding a DSDECOD value. No retained section states the additional source-record SCREEN FAILURE exclusion used by adsl.yaml DS_EOS.

Define-XML ADSL.DCDECOD and workbook Methods row 100 specify the disposition-event category without selecting among repeated qualifying events. No retained section states adsl.yaml DS_EOS's earliest-DSSTDTC selection.

Define-XML ADSL.DCSREAS describes grouping DCDECOD and lists 'I/E Not Met' as an allowed output but supplies no DSTERM condition. No retained section or workbook method states the PROTOCOL ENTRY CRITERIA NOT MET override used by adsl.yaml DCSREAS.

Define-XML ADSL.DCSREAS allows the coded value 'Completed' and describes grouping completion status without stating a blank result for completers. No retained section or workbook method documents adsl.yaml DCSREAS's explicit suppression when DSDECOD='COMPLETED'.

Define-XML ADSL.DCSREAS and its CL.DISCREAS codelist enumerate output categories but do not pair source terms with 'Sponsor Decision' or 'Withdrew Consent'. No retained section or workbook method states the two source-to-target pairings implemented by adsl.yaml DCSREAS.

Define-XML ADSL.DCSREAS and workbook Methods row 101 describe grouping DCDECOD but provide no complete mapping, including the condition for 'I/E Not Met' and treatment of completed subjects. The CL.DISCREAS output list and original MT.ADSL.DCREASCD method link identify the output and its categories without completing that computation.

Define-XML IG.ADSL lines 275-276 and workbook Variables row 190 bind DCSREAS to the DCREASCD method, so the REF.DCSREAS predicate follows ADSL.DISCONFL. The 110 discrepancies arise where the published grouped reason and DISCONFL are empty, making the documented inequality true.

missed.quote: All patients in DM were included in ADSL.
missed.reason: ADRG page-11 states the dataset population, but no claim cites this record-selection statement. The actual selector is the top-level filter DM.ACTARMCD <> 'Scrnfail', with no rows id; reconciling that selector and the screen-failure exclusions in raw Define-XML IG.ADSL and workbook Datasets row 5 with the ADRG statement is outside the current variable-derivation rules.
